name: labs/ari1127__sr830
title: SRS SR830 lock-in amplifier
intro: SRS SR830 lock-in amplifier, adapted from ari1127/sr830. It reads `x`, `y`, `r`, `theta` and 14 more; sets `frequency`, `amplitude`, `phase`, `reference_source` and 4 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ari1127__sr830 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ari1127__sr830 --backend fake --mcp
